description:
Casting time: 1 minute

A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for 8 hours, or until you spend an action to dismiss it. Roll Lore to see if you trigger any additional effects.

Creatures and objects are barred from passing through the dome. Spells and other magical effects can't extend through the dome or be cast through it. The dome is opaque from the outside, of any color you choose, but it is transparent from the inside.

While the dome is in place, you may spend an action to adjust the interior temperature, humidity and light levels, or grant a single creature passage into or out of the dome.

If you leave the dome, the spell ends.
name: Leomund's Tiny Hut

improvements.name: Leomund's Slightly Larger Hut
improvements.description: You may create a dome with a radius up to short range.

successes:
✨: You may choose to have the exterior of the dome take on the appearance of the surrounding terrain, or of a creature or object typically found in the area. If you do, your roll result becomes the Difficulty. A creature inspecting the dome must roll Awareness against the Difficulty to discover that the dome is not what it seems.

🌞: The dome lasts for up to 1 day, and any creature that touches the exterior of the dome takes 3d10 damage and is flung back 25 feet.

💀: Check a Condition. The dome remains in place indefinitely, is opaque instead of transparent from the inside, you cannot control the environment inside it, and your roll result becomes the Difficulty. To attempt to dispel the dome, you must spend another minute and 3 MP, then roll Lore against the Difficulty. On a pass, the dome is dispelled.
